max_interest_rate_pa.notes: Default interest on unpaid fees: 10% per annum simple interest.

max_interest_rate_pa_by_special_resoluti.notes: VIC does not permit a higher rate by special resolution.

interest_grace_period_days.notes: No statutory grace period — interest accrues from due date.

can_transfer_between_funds.notes: Transfers between maintenance and general funds permitted via maintenance fund regime.

inter_fund_transfer_resolution_required.notes: Special resolution required for maintenance fund transfers. Allowed values: none, ordinary, general_meeting, special, prohibited.

overbudget_threshold_pct.notes: VIC does not impose a statutory over-budget cap.

overbudget_requires_resolution_above_pct.notes: No statutory over-budget resolution trigger in VIC.

trust_withdrawal_authority_roles.notes: Trust withdrawals authorised by the registered owners corporation manager per EAA.

trial_balance_deadline_days.legislation: Estate Agents Act 1980 (VIC); Estate Agents (Professional Conduct) Regulations
trial_balance_deadline_days.notes: Monthly trial balance required per professional standards — 30 days after month-end.

audit_deadline.notes: Tier 1 (>100 lots or >$200k) and Tier 2 (>50 lots or >$75k) schemes must be audited before AGM.

pooled_trust_permitted.notes: Separate trust accounts required per scheme (s.122(2)(c)), with exceptions for same-plan consent (s.122(3)) and statutory trusts.

interest_belongs_to.notes: Interest on trust funds accrues to the scheme per s.122(4). Allowed values: scheme, statutory_account, body_corporate.

committee_spending_cap_formula.notes: VIC does not impose a per-lot committee spending cap formula.

min_withholding_pct_no_abn.notes: ATO PAYG withholding: 47% on payments to suppliers without ABN.

levy_interest_rate_min_percent.notes: OC may resolve a lower rate.

audit_threshold_budget_aud.notes: Tier 2 audit trigger: fees collected >$75k OR >50 lots. Tier 1: >$200k OR >100 lots.

audit_threshold_lots.notes: Tier 1 mandates full external audit: >100 lots or >$200k fees collected.

financial_statements_deadline_months.notes: Financial statements must be tabled at AGM within 3 months of year-end.

sinking_fund_review_years.notes: Maintenance plan must be reviewed every 10 years.

building_insurance_required.notes: Building insurance at replacement value — mandatory.

manager_contract_max_years.notes: Owners corporation manager contract max 5 years.

record_inspection_days.notes: Records must be available for inspection within 10 days of request.

capital_funding_standard_notice_days.legislation: Owners Corporations Act 2006 (VIC) s.31; Consumer Affairs Victoria fees guidance
capital_funding_standard_notice_days.notes: Fee notices are issued in approved form and generally provide at least 28 days for payment.

capital_funding_emergency_notice_days.notes: No shorter generic emergency special-fee period is encoded; urgent works must use legal-review override.

capital_funding_notice_period_verified.legislation: Owners Corporations Act 2006 (VIC) s.31; Consumer Affairs Victoria fees guidance
capital_funding_notice_period_verified.notes: The 28-day first fee notice payment period is encoded from official Victorian guidance.

capital_funding_resolution_required.notes: Special fees usually require ordinary resolution; a special resolution is required where the special fee is more than double current annual fees.

capital_funding_special_resolution_trigg.notes: Consumer Affairs Victoria states special resolution is required where special fees are more than double current annual fees.

capital_funding_allocation_basis.notes: Annual and special fees are generally charged by lot liability.

capital_funding_benefit_principle_availa.notes: The benefit principle may affect maintenance and repair cost allocation where lot owners benefit substantially more than others.

capital_funding_tenant_consultation_requ.legislation: Owners Corporations Act 2006 (VIC); Consumer Affairs Victoria maintenance guidance
capital_funding_tenant_consultation_requ.notes: Occupiers and tenants may need works-entry notice and must comply with owners corporation rules; tenant-impact communications should be tracked separately from levy votes.

capital_funding_hardship_notice_required.legislation: Owners Corporations Act 2006 (VIC) s.31; Consumer Affairs Victoria hardship guidance
capital_funding_hardship_notice_required.notes: VIC fee notices and recovery workflows should support hardship and payment-plan pathways.

capital_funding_hybrid_legal_review_requ.notes: Hybrid owner-funded and loan-funded structures require recorded legal approval before notices or credits are issued.
